purpose: Correct only BuildKit parent references after the terminal failed COPY-only attempt; same two local parent images and collector bytes, then fresh gated checks.

Resolve and retain each resulting immutable image ID, prepare fresh exact definitions and scope under September25/27 authority, and bind the generated collector review to this parent approval before launch.

Only after conformance passes, run the same explicit-request pair; only after complete captures and positive bound loading, run the optional pair. Four task turns total, no holdouts, no full comparison, no admission or threshold changes.

Restore the approved proxy stopped and remove only new transient workers/private security snapshots. Retain the two new image tags/IDs, reports, logs, old images, volumes, backups and unrelated user work.
